author: Cryonex
quote: An Incredible Open World Wasted on a Terrible StoryI have to give Rockstar credit where it’s due. The world of GTA 6 is absolutely stunning. The attention to detail, the atmosphere, the living and breathing city — it’s genuinely impressive. Vice City feels more alive than **** a beautiful world doesn’t automatically make a great **** story is a massive disappointment. The characters lack depth, the writing feels weak, and the whole experience fails to deliver the unforgettable criminal drama I expected from Rockstar.Lucia is an obnoxious, insufferable **** who constantly acts like everything revolves around her. And Jason? He’s a spineless cuckold with absolutely no backbone or personality of his own. Instead of being a compelling protagonist, he spends his time acting like Lucia’s obedient little servant, following her around and doing whatever she wants. Their relationship feels less like a criminal partnership and more like watching a pathetic lapdog desperately trying to please his master. Neither character comes close to the iconic personalities Rockstar has created in the past.What makes it even worse is the lack of freedom. GTA is supposed to be a chaotic, unpredictable sandbox where players can do almost anything. Yet the game feels strangely restrictive. Adult interactions are limited, and certain NPCs and groups seem to be protected from the kind of unrestricted sandbox violence the franchise is known for.I’m not asking for a morality lesson. I’m asking for a GTA game that treats its fictional world consistently instead of deciding what players are allowed to do based on arbitrary restrictions.Rockstar created an incredible playground but forgot what made it fun in the first place.Amazing world. Terrible story. Disappointing freedom.1/10.
